title: odontarrhena gehamensis
intro: Odontarrhena gehamensis, commonly known as Geham, is a flowering plant species native to Australia. Geham has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its proven health benefits. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, act as an expectorant, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Geham include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is required to fully understand its effects and applications.
